title: Junior Revenue & Accounts Analyst
description_text:
Our client is a well-established organisation in Malta, committed to operational excellence and delivering high-quality services. They are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Junior Revenue & Accounts Analyst to join their Finance team and support the company's financial reporting and revenue analysis activities.
 Position Summary
 The Junior Revenue & Accounts Analyst will support the Finance team by analysing revenue, maintaining accurate financial records, assisting with accounting processes, and contributing to the timely preparation of financial reports. This role is ideal for a finance professional looking to develop their career in a dynamic and collaborative environment.
 Key Responsibilities
 Prepare weekly and monthly revenue reports.
 Analyse revenue trends and identify variances.
 Monitor electronic payment transactions, card payments, online sales, and other revenue streams.
 Reconcile revenue between operational and accounting systems.
 Support revenue assurance initiatives by identifying anomalies, trends, and potential revenue leakages.
 Collaborate with internal departments to improve revenue reporting and data accuracy.
 Record and process journal entries accurately.
 Perform bank, revenue, and balance sheet reconciliations.
 Maintain fixed asset records and assist with depreciation schedules.
 Support month-end and year-end closing activities.
 Assist in the preparation of financial statements and audit processes.
 Carry out other duties related to the role as required by the business.
 Requirements
 Diploma in Finance, Accounting, or a related field, or currently pursuing a Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related discipline.
 Minimum of 2 years of experience in a similar role.
 Good understanding of accounting principles and financial procedures.
 Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Microsoft Excel.
 Excellent attention to detail and analytical skills.
 Good organisational and time management abilities.
 Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
 Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
 Positive attitude and willingness to learn in a fast-paced environment.
 What We Offer
 Competitive remuneration package.
 Supportive and collaborative working environment.
 Opportunities for professional development and career progression.
 Ongoing training and exposure to a variety of finance functions.
 Join Our Client's Team
 If you are passionate about finance, enjoy working with numbers, and are looking to build your career within a dynamic organisation, we would love to hear from you. Apply today and take the next step in your professional journey.
